name: hasebe_t800s_3900_2b_cai
reference: Hasebe, Higuchi, Yokozeki & Takeda, 'Dataset of compression after impact testing on carbon fiber reinforced plastic laminates', Data in Brief 60 (2025) 111509; Mendeley Data 10.17632/8scdmfdcfb.3 (CC BY 4.0), files 'Low velocity impact testing condition and damage_v0.2', 'Specimen size_v0.2' and 'Compression after impact strength_v0.2'. Toray T800S/3900-2B, 8 layups (c8-c24 [0/90]ns, q8-q24 [45/0/-45/90]ns, r0 [0/45/0/90/0/-45/0/45/0/-45]s, r45 [45/-45/0/45/-45/90/45/-45/45/-45]s). Every specimen struck by a hemispherical impactor (HemiA 12.7 mm, HemiB 25.4 mm, HemiC 31.8 mm), the 15.9 mm flat-ended impactor or the 60 deg cone (Coni60) is carried, with its measured thickness, coupon size, C-scan projected delamination area and dent depth. Impact: 80 x 80 mm plate clamped between plates with a 60 x 60 mm window (impact_panel). CAI: trimmed to 80 mm (0 deg, loaded) x 50 mm and tested to JIS K 7089. The impactor mass is not reported: 5.5 kg is assumed. In the LVI sheet the '[J/mm]' and '[J]' unit labels are swapped; impact_energy_J is the column whose values equal energy per mm x thickness. measured_pristine_MPa is the mean strength of the layup's undamaged coupons, the basis of the dataset's own strength-reduction ratio. The 120 deg cone (Coni120) is omitted: the model's cone has a 30 deg half-angle. Hasebe does not give the cones' shank diameter; 12.7 mm is entered, which the model does not use for a conical impactor. The model's impactor shape and diameter factors are fitted to these data.
gate_note: The predicted damage area matches the C-scans (median ratio 1.00 for every impactor), but the knockdown map scores 21% MAE (empirical) against 30% for a constant knockdown. It misses the layup dependence (cross-ply c16 keeps 0.64 of its strength, quasi-isotropic q16 0.84, at similar damage area) and over-penalises the thin, fixture-limited coupons (0.64 predicted, 0.73 measured on average). Undamaged coupons fail at 0.4-0.6x the unnotched strength, so cases are scored on knockdown (measured_pristine_MPa).
